def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import glob
    import pandas as pd

    pattern = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/State MSA Identity Theft data/*.csv"
    paths = sorted(glob.glob(pattern))
    if not paths:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No files matched pattern: {pattern}")

    dfs = []
    for p in paths:
        df = pd.read_csv(p, dtype=str)
        df["_source_file"] = p.split("/")[-1]
        dfs.append(df)

    out = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
    return out

def process(loadStateMsaIdTheft2024) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = loadStateMsaIdTheft2024.copy()

    # Standardize column names
    c0 = "Metropolitan Areas: Identity Theft Reports"
    c1 = "Unnamed: 1"
    df = df.rename(columns={c0: "metropolitanArea", c1: "reports"})

    # Drop obvious non-data rows
    df["metropolitanArea"] = df["metropolitanArea"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["reports"] = df["reports"].astype(str).str.strip()

    # Remove rows where metro area is missing/NaN-like
    na_like = {"", "nan", "none", "na"}
    df = df[~df["metropolitanArea"].str.lower().isin(na_like)].copy()

    # Remove header rows and source/footer rows
    df = df[df["metropolitanArea"].str.lower() != "metropolitan area"].copy()
    df = df[~df["metropolitanArea"].str.lower().str.startswith("metropolitan areas")].copy()
    df = df[~df["metropolitanArea"].str.lower().str.startswith("source:")].copy()

    # Parse reports as numeric; non-numeric becomes NaN then dropped
    df["reports"] = pd.to_numeric(df["reports"].str.replace(",", "", regex=False), errors="coerce")
    df = df.dropna(subset=["reports"]).copy()
    df["reports"] = df["reports"].astype(int)

    # Heuristic for cross-state MSAs: name contains a hyphenated state list like "..., NY-NJ-PA"
    # We'll look for a comma then a space then at least two state abbreviations separated by hyphens.
    df["isCrossStateMsa"] = df["metropolitanArea"].str.contains(r",\s*[A-Z]{2}(?:-[A-Z]{2})+\b", regex=True)

    return df[["metropolitanArea", "reports", "_source_file", "isCrossStateMsa"]]

Add boolean isCrossStateMsa based on metro name containing multiple state abbreviations after comma, pattern /,\s*[A-Z]{2}(-[A-Z]{2})+\b/. Output [metropolitanArea, reports, _source_file, isCrossStateMsa].

Compute total 2024 Identity Theft reports from cross-state MSAs: filter cleanStateMsaIdTheft2024 to rows where isCrossStateMsa == True (metro name has multiple state abbreviations like 'NY-NJ-PA'); sum integer 'reports' across those rows; return single-row DataFrame with column totalCrossStateMsaReports2024.
